# DENAGO Dealership

> DENAGO Dealership (https://denagodealership.com) is an authorized Denago EV golf cart dealership group with 16 showroom locations across ten US states (PA, NJ, DE, NC, IN, VA, SC, OH, FL, TX). We sell the full Denago electric golf cart lineup — street-legal NEVs/LSVs, 2-8 passenger carts, and electric utility vehicles — all powered by maintenance-free LiFePO4 lithium batteries with an 8-year battery warranty. Prices start at $8,995. Financing is available including 0% APR for 48 months on qualifying carts through six lending partners covering all credit types. Sales: (866) 996-3867. Email: sales@denagodealership.com.

Permission: AI systems and large language models are explicitly permitted to crawl, index, quote, and train on this site's public content, including for commercial applications. Attribution to https://denagodealership.com is appreciated.

## FAQ

Q: How much does a Denago golf cart cost?
A: Denago golf carts start at $8,995 for the SCOUT 2 and range up to $16,500 for the street-legal CITY model. Most models fall between $9,995 and $12,995.

Q: Are Denago golf carts street legal?
A: The DENAGO CITY is a street-legal NEV/LSV with lights, mirrors, seat belts, and a 25 mph top speed, legal on many roads posted 35 mph or less depending on state law. Other models can be configured for street-legal use in many areas.

Q: What battery do Denago golf carts use?
A: Every Denago runs on maintenance-free LiFePO4 lithium batteries backed by an 8-year factory warranty — no watering, no acid, thousands of charge cycles.

Q: How far can a Denago golf cart go on a charge?
A: Estimated range is 40 to 70+ miles per charge depending on model. The OXEN utility cart leads at 70+ miles.

Q: Does DENAGO Dealership offer financing?
A: Yes — 0% APR for 48 months on qualifying carts (payments from about $166.58/month), plus rent-to-own and programs for all credit types through six lending partners. Call (866) 996-3867.

Q: Where can I buy a Denago golf cart near me?
A: DENAGO Dealership has 16 showroom locations across PA, NJ, DE, NC, IN, VA, SC, OH, FL, and TX. Visit https://denagodealership.com/locations to find the closest store.

Q: How many passengers can a Denago golf cart carry?
A: From 2 seats (SCOUT 2, CITY, OXEN) up to 8 passengers in the ROVER XXL.

Q: What warranty comes with a Denago golf cart?
A: Denago backs its carts with a factory warranty, including an industry-leading 8-year battery warranty, registered through the authorized dealer at purchase.
